SONOS_AUDIO_CENTRAL.NAME: Audio Central
SONOS_AUDIO_CENTRAL.DESCRIPTION: Controls several Sonos Control blocks together: on/off, volume (keeps the ratio between the players), favorites, doorbell and alarm sounds

TOGGLE.NAME: Toggle zone (TgZ)
TOGGLE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: switches all players off when one plays, otherwise on

VOLUME.NAME: Volume (V)
VOLUME.DESCRIPTION: Sets the volume in %; the loudest players get this value, the others keep their ratio

NEXT_FAVORITE.NAME: Next favorite (S+)
NEXT_FAVORITE.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: plays the next radio station of the favorites

BELL.NAME: Bell
BELL.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: plays the doorbell sound on all players

ALARM.NAME: Alarm
ALARM.DESCRIPTION: Pulse: plays the alarm sound on all players

LOCK.NAME: Off / lock (Off)
LOCK.DESCRIPTION: 1: pauses all players and locks the central, 0: unlocks it

DISABLE_PERIPHERY.NAME: Disable periphery (DisPc)
DISABLE_PERIPHERY.DESCRIPTION: 1: ignores the command inputs from links (child lock); the visualization still works

PLAYING1.NAME: Playing player 1
PLAYING1.DESCRIPTION: Link the Play output of Sonos Control block 1

PLAYING2.DESCRIPTION: Link the Play output of Sonos Control block 2

PLAY.NAME: Play / pause
PLAY.DESCRIPTION: 1 play, 0 pause (link to the Play/Pause input of the players)

VOLUME.NAME: Volume
VOLUME.DESCRIPTION: The same volume for all players

VOLUME_UP.NAME: Volume +
VOLUME_UP.DESCRIPTION: Sends 1 for every volume up command

VOLUME_DOWN.NAME: Volume -
VOLUME_DOWN.DESCRIPTION: Sends 1 for every volume down command

RADIO_STATION.NAME: Radio station
RADIO_STATION.DESCRIPTION: Station of the selected favorite (link to the radio station input of the Sonos Control blocks or of the Sonos devices)

SOUND_URL.NAME: Sound URL
SOUND_URL.DESCRIPTION: URL of the bell or alarm sound (link to the play sound URL input of the players)

SOUND_TRIGGER.NAME: Play sound
SOUND_TRIGGER.DESCRIPTION: Sends 1 after the sound URL (link to the play sound trigger of the players)

PLAYER_VOLUME1.NAME: Volume player 1
PLAYER_VOLUME1.DESCRIPTION: Volume for player 1 that keeps the ratio between the players

PLAYER_VOLUME2.NAME: Volume player 2
PLAYER_VOLUME2.DESCRIPTION: Volume for player 2 that keeps the ratio between the players

PLAYER_VOLUME3.DESCRIPTION: Volume for player 3 that keeps the ratio between the players

PLAYER_VOLUME8.NAME: Volume player 8
PLAYER_VOLUME8.DESCRIPTION: Volume for player 8 that keeps the ratio between the players

FAVORITES.NAME: Favorites
FAVORITES.DESCRIPTION: Radio stations for S+, from the station list of the server (older entries like the TuneIn id s8007 keep working)

BELL_URL.NAME: Bell sound URL
BELL_URL.DESCRIPTION: MP3 that the players play for the bell

ALARM_URL.NAME: Alarm sound URL
ALARM_URL.DESCRIPTION: MP3 that the players play for the alarm

PLAYERS.NAME: Players
PLAYERS.DESCRIPTION: Pick the Sonos Control blocks instead of linking them: they get play/pause, volume, tracks, favorites and sounds directly and are counted. Pick or link a player, not both.

RADIO_STATIONS.NAME: Radio stations
RADIO_STATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Stations for the visu tile, from the station list of the server (own stations under Configure > Radio stations); selecting one in the visu plays it via the radio station output. Older lists (Name=TuneIn id or stream url) keep working

RADIO_STATION.NAME: Radio station
RADIO_STATION.DESCRIPTION: The station for play (default), from the station list of the server

STATE.NAME: State
STATE.DESCRIPTION: Track that is playing right now
